title: stage's Overview tab
howToOpen: Open the event, click the stage's tab, then the Overview sub-tab.

reviewed.note: Second map for the Overview (runs with 04-overview.json on the same visit): the Product Sheet, every rank of the line-item Bidding Summary, and the stage's Location (which the console fills from the stage DESCRIPTION, eventDetails.jsx:1479-1490).

groups.title: The Product Sheet shows each line item's requested quantity, unit, delivery location and other buyer values as the API returns them
The Bidding Summary lists every rank's vendor and quoted price, best first, as the API ranks them

special.label: Bidding Summary by rank
special.code: biddingSummary.jsx:23-84 (column i = rank i); selectors.js:7477-7575 (cell = line_data.data.inline_data[tp][l_i][col], raw)

groups.title: Order Details show the stage's title and location (the stage description) as the API returns them
When savings are compared on the whole lot, the Overview's Savings Summary shows the same savings the stage's Responses tab shows

fields.label: Savings amount (lot)
fields.code: eventDetails.jsx:477-495 (lot mode: amount = first bidder's layers[0].savings_with_strategy); savingsInfo.jsx:17-22
fields.note: The Responses tab's savings strip shows aggregate_savings (savingsStrip.jsx:26-69). In lot mode the Overview card instead reads the first bidder's own savings record. When that record is empty the card shows '–' while the strip shows the amount: the two screens disagree for the same stage.
